_doc: Cycle 14AR-fix5 — manual overrides for ChannelAdvisor data gaps. Tom (auto-parts-specialist) audit identified BLOCKERs where the CA fitment snapshot is missing real-world OEM data. These overrides are merged into ymm_dimensions.json AFTER the CA-snapshot pass so the canonical CA data still wins where present, but holes get filled. Each entry must cite the upstream gap so a future CA refresh can supersede it.
_format: Same shape as ymm_dimensions.json. Keys: '<year>|<Make>|<Model>'. Values merged into the CA-derived entry — arrays are unioned, not replaced.
_review_cadence: Re-validate against CA snapshot every quarter. If CA upstream now provides the data, drop the override.

2014|Ford|F-150._reason: CA snapshot has 5.5'/6.5' bed entries for 2014 F-150 but is missing 8' bed (Regular Cab Styleside long bed, real OEM config). Affects tonneau covers + bed mats.

2019|Ram|1500._reason: CA snapshot has zero bedLengths in subattributes for 2019 Ram 1500 (DT 4th-gen). DT-gen Ram 1500 ships in 5.7' (Crew Cab short) and 6.4' (Quad Cab + Crew Cab long) bed configurations. 8' bed was NOT offered on DT.

2020|Ram|1500._reason: Same DT-gen as 2019. CA snapshot also missing bedLengths for 2020.

2021|Ram|1500._reason: Same DT-gen. CA snapshot missing bedLengths.

2022|Ram|1500._reason: Same DT-gen. CA snapshot missing bedLengths.

2023|Ram|1500._reason: Same DT-gen. CA snapshot missing bedLengths.

2024|Ram|1500._reason: Same DT-gen. CA snapshot missing bedLengths.

2019|Jeep|Wrangler JL._reason: CA snapshot has zero entries for 2019 Wrangler entirely. JL launched MY2018; 2019 is a real year. Trims + dimensions copied from JL-gen baseline. Products tagged for the 2018-current JL generation should be visible to 2019 owners.

2020|Jeep|Wrangler JL._reason: JL gen, EcoDiesel arrived 2020. Same baseline as 2019 + EcoDiesel.

2014|Jeep|Wrangler._reason: CA snapshot trim list contains only Unlimited (4-door) variants. JK gen offers 2-door variants too: Sport, Sahara, Rubicon, Willys Wheeler. Add the 2-door trim names + the 2-Door doors entry.

2016|Jeep|Wrangler._reason: JK gen 2-door trims missing. 75th Anniversary launched.

2018|Jeep|Wrangler JK._reason: Last year of JK gen sold alongside JL. 2-door variants present.
